title: Zesty Irish Chicken Tagine
description: A savory and light Irish dish featuring chicken, sriracha, and traditional tagine cooking, perfect for a post-workout meal, and friendly to sugar-free diets.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine or a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the chicken to the pot and cook until it is browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the sriracha sauce, thyme, salt, and pepper to the pot and stir to combine.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and simmer the tagine for 25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve the chicken and sauce hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
